item.text: I'm calculating the April–September monthly HH totals per village and cross-checking against the pre-built Consolidated sheet.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd

xl = pd.ExcelFile('mis_apr_sep_2025.xlsx')
months = ['Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep']
frames = []
for m in months:
    df = xl.parse(m)
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]
    hh_col = 'No. of HH' if 'No. of HH' in df.columns else 'Households reached'
    sub = df[['Village', hh_col]].copy()
    sub['Month'] = m
    frames.append(sub)

monthly = pd.concat(frames)
monthly = monthly[monthly['Village'] "'!= '"'TOTAL']

totals = monthly.groupby('Village')[hh_col].sum().rename('Computed total')

cons = xl.parse('Consolidated')
cons.columns = ['Village', 'Total HH (Consolidated sheet)', 'SHGs', 'Water', 'Farmers']
merged = totals.join(cons.set_index('Village')['Total HH (Consolidated sheet)'])
merged['match'] = merged['Computed total'] == merged['Total HH (Consolidated sheet)']
merged = merged.sort_values('Computed total', ascending=False)
print(merged.to_string())
print('\\nAll match:', merged['match'].all())
print('Top 5 (computed):')
print(merged.head(5)[['Computed total']].to_string())
EOF"

import pandas as pd

xl = pd.ExcelFile('mis_apr_sep_2025.xlsx')
months = ['Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep']
frames = []
for m in months:
    df = xl.parse(m)
    sub = pd.DataFrame({'Village': df.iloc[:,0], 'HH': pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[:,1], errors='coerce'), 'Month': m})
    sub = sub[sub['Village'].astype(str).str.strip() "'!= '"'TOTAL']
    frames.append(sub)

monthly = pd.concat(frames)
assert monthly['HH'].notna().all(), \"non-numeric HH values present\"

totals = monthly.groupby('Village')['HH'].sum().rename('Total HH (Apr-Sep)')

cons = xl.parse('Consolidated')
cons.columns = ['Village', 'Consolidated HH', 'SHGs', 'Water', 'Farmers']
merged = totals.join(cons.set_index('Village')['Consolidated HH'])
merged['match'] = merged['Total HH (Apr-Sep)'] == merged['Consolidated HH']
merged = merged.sort_values('Total HH (Apr-Sep)', ascending=False)
print(merged.to_string())
print('\\nAll match Consolidated sheet:', merged['match'].all())
EOF"

Note: `No. of HH` (Apr–May) and `Households reached`/`HH Covered` (Jun–Sep) all refer to the same monthly HH metric, so sums are comparable across the six months.
